dye.encoding: mask R = band*50 (1 highlight,2 base,3 shade1,4 shade2,5 deep), mask G = region id*60 (1..n, see regions); R=0 = fixed colour (not dyed)

geometry: torso shell (8 rings x 12 sides, tapered waist, alternating hem fold columns)

fit.why: same topology, only the hem rings move (up/in) and blouse out

untucked.layerNote: hem OVER the pants waistband (the pants waist compresses under it)

tucked.layerNote: hem collapsed INSIDE the pants band (1 mm, under the compressed 2.5 mm band)

sleeves.why: different length/ring count. short = elbow-length so it can hide Body_upper_arm

pld_L.note: shoulder/upper sleeve pulls in under a pauldron on that side

pld_R.note: shoulder/upper sleeve pulls in under a pauldron on that side
